items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each guard is short and has a comment that explains it ("Don't override an object fetched by a nested prefetch."). It uses the existing `is_cached` API and follows the style of the code around it. The tests have clear names and docstrings.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The change reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`) and adds no new bookkeeping. The same small guard appears in three prefetch loops, but each loop already exists separately, so this is not real copy-paste. No dead code or debug output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: This is a simple conditional `continue` with no exception handling and no magic constants. Children without a cached value still get the parent assigned, so plain prefetch behaviour is unchanged. The full suite shows the same 6 failures with and without the change, so nothing new broke.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The guard `if self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): continue` is added in the reverse many-to-one manager and also in `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor` (`self.related.field.is_cached`). The parent is still assigned when nothing is cached. The new tests cover both the reverse-FK and one-to-one cases.
